publisher: Oregon DLCD statewide zoning compilation (Oregon Zoning layer, City of Wasco)
notes: Statewide DLCD zoning compilation (state GEOHub Oregon Zoning), filtered to the City of Wasco in Sherman County. zone is the state-standardized code (orZCode); localZCode/localZDesc hold the city code where filled. Duplicate polygons per unit may occur. Not in or-sherman, which holds Sherman County, Moro and Grass Valley only.
